lines.vo: Ever read something great online, then couldn't find it a week later? This is Gleaner, a plugin for Claude that fixes that.
lines.motion: Logo pops; headline builds word by word; name card on "This is Gleaner".

scene.headline: Stop losing the best parts of the {web.}

lines.vo: Tabs pile up, bookmarks lose their context, and notes turn into a pile of pasted text with no source.

scene.title: Saving things is easy. {Finding them isn't.}

items.title: Too many tabs
items.desc: Kept open "for later" until the browser crashes

items.title: Dead bookmarks
items.desc: A link with no idea why you saved it

items.title: Messy notes
items.desc: Pasted text with no source or summary

lines.vo: Gleaner reads the page, skips the ads and navigation, and saves a short clip: a TL;DR, key points, takeaways, a category and tags.

scene.title: Every page becomes a {tagged, summarized clip.}

lines.vo: No commands to memorize. Open a page and say "save this page." Add a reason after it, and Gleaner keeps that as the clip's note.

turns.text: keep this, good intro to view transitions

lines.vo: Researching across sites? Highlight a part and say "add this." Keep going across tabs, then say "done, save them." You get one clip with every source linked.

scene.title: Grab bits from many tabs, {save once.}

steps.title: Highlight
steps.desc: Select a part and say `add this`

steps.title: Keep going
steps.desc: Add parts from other tabs and sites

lines.vo: It works on YouTube too. Gleaner reads the transcript and saves key moments that link to the exact second.
Keep clips in the chat, or save them to Google Drive, Notion, a private Claude artifact, a Cowork project, or your Claude Code project.
Not sure what to do with a clip? Ask "what should I follow up on?" and Gleaner suggests three next steps and saves them into the clip.

scene.title: Turn a clip into {three next steps.}

turns.text: what should I follow up on?
